newsitem.title: USA: Daschle says securities bill may face problems.
newsitem.headline: Daschle says securities bill may face problems.

text.p: Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle said on Monday that a major securities bill passed by the House Saturday may face problems in the Senate.
The Senate is to adjourn this week and failure to pass the bill would end any prospects of enactment this year.
The bill would overhaul state and federal securities regulation and end local-level scrutiny of mutual funds.
Daschle told reporters that "as I understand it, there may be some problems" with the bill because of some objections to it in the Senate. He did not say what the objections were.
Under Senate rules any senator could object to Senate consideration of the bill.
